items.question: Within how many days will this retailer credit the refund after checking a returned item in the online or pick-up return methods?
items.fact: Refunds credited within 4-15 days after return checking.

items.question: When returning an item to a store, can the customer choose a Credit Note instead of a refund to their original payment method?
items.gold: Yes, a Credit Note that can be spent instantly in-store or online.
items.fact: Store returns allow a Credit Note option instead of refund.
